component.name: Phantom Browser
component.summary: Privacy-focused browser with DPI bypass and built-in VPN

description.p: Phantom Browser is a Firefox-based browser designed for privacy and censorship circumvention. It includes a built-in ad/tracker blocker, Deep Packet Inspection (DPI) bypass engine, and VPN support via sing-box (VLESS+REALITY).

ul.li: Built-in ad and tracker blocker (EasyList + EasyPrivacy)
DPI bypass engine with TLS record splitting and TCP fragmentation
Integrated VPN via sing-box (VLESS+REALITY protocol)
Vertical tabs, split view, workspaces
Command palette and focus mode
AI sidebar integration
DNS over HTTPS with Encrypted Client Hello (ECH)
Telemetry fully disabled
